simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֶלֶף (H507) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֶלֶף (ʼEleph) means Eleph , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 18 28.

definitions.full: H507. Eleph III. אֶ֫לֶף proper name, of a location city in Benjamin, ׳הָא Josh 18:28 ; perhaps Lifta northwest from Jerusalem Survey iii. 18 (compare II. אֶלֶף 2 for probably meaning).
